notes: route_family is an annotation-level grouping used only for reporting; it is NOT a production ontology.

Draft revision of a pending workout plan is handled by routePendingDraftTurn/tryReviseWorkoutPlanDraft, outside the global router; gold route for revision turns is WRITE_ACTION (proposal behind confirmation). Observed route may be absent from traces and is then reported as UNOBSERVED, not silently matched.
Confirmation/status utterances are classified before the global router; they are labeled with the CONFIRMATION_BOUNDARY family.
